mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane bag and placing the nucleus inside was most worthwhile: the pictures made the cell boundary and the nucleus's separate envelope clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the two membrane proteins was somewhat repetitive, although their different pictures helped explain their jobs.

surprise.text: I was surprised that oxygen can cross the lipid itself, while water channels and sugar carriers provide other routes.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt arbitrary; the goals and pictures gave each one a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would try another chapter because building the cell piece by piece made the structures easier to picture, though the repeated fittings were less interesting.
